name: halo2
title: halo2 · zkworld
description: The halo2 framework as a running submod of zkworld: its toolchain, starters and every halo2 project here. PLONKish circuits in Rust (zcash halo2_proofs): columns, gates, regions. The starter's binary is the runner and checks the circuit with MockProver; `cargo test` runs the native tests.
